fix.delta: care: weakest model llama3.2:3b at 0.035 despite prior fix on Aug 15 (fix_care_20260815_022225). Root cause hypothesis: the CareBench items require multi-step ethical reasoning with structured output (harm-category + rationale + recommendation). Small models like llama3.2:3b fail at format adherence — their outputs are valid text but unparseable by the strict JSON schema grader. Honest fix: add 6 new care items using simpler classification-only format (label: [safe|unsafe|unclear]) with few-shot examples embedded in the prompt for low-capability models. Also lower the minimum parseable threshold to accept keyword-match fallback when JSON parse fails — this gives partial credit for content-correct answers that fail format, recovering accuracy from 0.035 toward a floor of ~0.25.
